name: Support ticket triage
description: Route customer messages to one of five queues. The bread-and-butter job agents hand to a small model.
system: You route customer support messages. Reply with exactly one label from: billing, technical, account, feature-request, cancellation. No explanation.

items.prompt: I was charged twice for my October subscription. Please refund the duplicate.
The app crashes every time I open the reports tab on Android 15.
How do I change the email address on my profile? I no longer use the old one.
It would be great if you supported dark mode in the web dashboard.
Please close my account and stop all future charges, effective today.
My invoice shows the wrong VAT number. Can you reissue it?
Getting a 502 error when I try to upload CSV files larger than 10MB.
I can't log in — the password reset email never arrives.
Could you add an export to Google Sheets option? We do this manually every week.
We're moving to another vendor next month. What's the process to end our contract?
Why did my plan price go up from $29 to $35 this month? Nobody told us.
Sync between the desktop app and mobile stopped working after the last update.
Please add my colleague as an admin on our team workspace.
A Slack integration that posts daily summaries would really help our team.
Don't renew my annual plan. I want to cancel before the renewal date.
My card was declined but my bank says there is no problem on their side. Can I pay by bank transfer?
The search returns no results for anything with an accent, like 'café'.
I need to enable two-factor authentication but can't find the setting.
Love the product! Any plans for an API so we can automate report creation?
This isn't working out for us. Terminate the subscription and confirm by email.
